name: godmode-paperwork
description: Controlled, local-first document workflow with deterministic evidence gates and packaging for Codex.

interface.longDescription: Build controlled document case files with immutable originals, local extraction and OCR, source-anchored claims, explicit review gates, integrity verification, and reproducible evidence archives. The plugin never installs tools, uploads files, submits forms, or replaces professional legal or tax review.
defaultPrompt: Create a local-first paperwork case and inventory my documents.
Extract this case and route only unresolved pages to OCR.
Validate the evidence and prepare a reproducible archive.
